coreLearnings.content: Backend testing: JUnit 5, Spring Boot Test with @SpringBootTest, @DataJpaTest, @WebMvcTest
Testcontainers: Using Testcontainers for PostgreSQL in integration tests
Frontend E2E: Playwright configured in shopro-res-web with test runner
Playwright config: playwright.config.ts with e2e/ tests and test-results/ output
Backend has 317 Java files - needs comprehensive test coverage
Frontend has 517 TSX/TS files - needs E2E and component tests
Key test scenarios: KDS real-time updates, inventory transactions, purchase order workflows, invoice matching
API testing: Controllers need @WebMvcTest or integration tests
Security testing: OAuth2, JWT endpoints need auth token handling
WebSocket testing: STOMP messages for KDS need special test setup

patternsEstablished: Use @SpringBootTest for full integration tests with @Testcontainers
Playwright: Use test.describe() for grouping, test.beforeEach() for setup
Frontend: Test critical user flows (login, ordering, inventory check)
knownPitfalls: Backend tests need better coverage - focus on services and repositories
E2E tests need proper wait conditions for WebSocket updates
Need to add test for AI invoice matching logic
Consider adding contract tests for API endpoints
